meta.evaluationDesign: Model family selected with expanding-window validation and a 2% simplicity tolerance; the latest observed target season is held out for final evaluation. Holdout performance is also reported across scoring-level, age and minutes groups.
limitations: Historical relationships may not persist into the projection season.
The model does not directly include injuries, transactions, coaching changes, lineup context, contract incentives or playoff role.
Training transitions require a player to remain eligible in the following season, creating survivorship/availability bias.
The historical error band is an empirical prediction-error summary, not a formal statistical confidence interval.
Subgroup holdout diagnostics are descriptive and are not statistical significance tests.

pts.label: Points
pts.selectionMethod: Expanding-window validation MAE with 2% simplicity tolerance

notes: All subgroup definitions use source-season information from the held-out sample; target-season outcomes are not used to define the groups.
Mean signed error is prediction minus actual; negative values indicate underprediction on average.
Subgroup results are descriptive diagnostics, not statistical significance tests.

scoringLevel.label: Scoring level
scoringLevel.basis: Source-season PTS rank within the held-out sample.
